breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect instruction: 'Replace the uniform distributed load with its resultant force wL acting at midspan' and 'Calculate the deflection contribution from the equivalent point load wL using δ = PL³/(48EI).' This is exactly the error identified in the inconsistency — treating the distributed load as a midspan point load resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior. The ground truth simply instructs using the two standard superposition cases (UDL formula 5wL⁴/384EI and point load formula PL³/48EI) without any such substitution. The agent failed to remove this incorrect approach and instead reinforced it.
